## 1. Goal

Make harness-spawning and cross-harness coordination first-class capabilities of the standard harness substrate, with auth-bound identity from day one.

Concretely:

- Any harness whose role config declares `allowedActions: [..., "scaffold_harness"]` can spawn children.
- Any marketplace template that declares `spawnable: { kind, requires }` can be spawned as a child.
- Children whose `parent_slug` is set automatically report completion back to their parent — no per-template hook authoring required.
- Every orchestrator understands it's running inside Papercusp, can see its parent / children / siblings at a glance, and can pull full state of any other harness on demand via authenticated read APIs.
- Any harness whose role config grants `send_message` can message any other harness, with a declared `reason` recorded in the audit log.
- **Every executeAction call is authenticated against a per-harness shared-secret token; harness identity is derived from the token binding, not from caller-supplied body fields. `parent_slug` and message `from_slug` are derived (not trusted), so spoofing is impossible at the protocol level.**
- The `papercup-org` template is the first template that uses these features, not a special case.

The user-facing demo: drop a directive into the `papercup-org` parent's inbox, manually invoke its director, watch it spawn children with full context of the org, watch them run while the parent can intervene mid-mission, watch completion flow back.

## 2. Scope

Closed-loop manual demo via standard substrate. End-to-end smokes must pass:

- **Smoke A** — papercup-org happy path (directive → spawn → first non-trivial file → completion message in parent inbox)
- **Smoke B** — generic non-`papercup-org` harness can also spawn children (proves the feature is substrate, not template-specific)
- **Smoke C** — neighbor visibility works (a child's prompt sees its parent's status; a parent's prompt sees its children's statuses; cross-harness supervisor message arrives in child's prompt-build)
- **Smoke D** — auth model holds: a request without a valid token, with a token bound to harness X claiming to be harness Y, or with a forged `callingHarness` body field, is rejected with 401/403

Autonomy (routine ticker, coordinator dispatch, auditor cadence) is a **separate plan** — not included here.

## 3. Non-goals

- Coordinator dispatch — `NEXT_HARNESS` parses but doesn't fire children autonomously.
- Auditor cadence — file exists, no scheduler invokes it.
- `add_directive_summary` — context bounded by prompt-build truncation instead.
- `mark_campaign_published`, `pause_project`, `resume_project` — useful, not needed for the loop.
- Briefings plugin — gone, dropped from manifest until source is restored or rebuilt.
- Many-directive scale, multi-week autonomy, KPI dashboards.
- Cross-machine spawn (parent on machine A, child on machine B).
- Spawn quotas / rate limiting per parent.
- Permission tiers beyond `allowedActions[]` and the auth token.
- Per-role addressing (`to: [<harness>:<role>]`); messages address harnesses, not roles within.
- `dryRun: true` for `scaffold_harness` — defer to v1.5.
- Cache-and-verify idempotency replay — v1 is cache-is-authoritative.
- Token rotation for compromised harnesses — manual reissue only in v1.

## 4. Architecture decisions (locked before code)

### Auth & identity

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Per-harness shared secret | `harness_<slug>.config_token` (random 256-bit, base64url) generated at scaffold time, written to `.papercusp/config.json` mode 0600 | Cryptographic identity binding; token serves as both authn and authz |
| Auth header | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every executeAction request | Standard, simple |
| Identity derivation | Executor looks up token in `harness_shared.token_index` to find which harness slug owns it. **`callingHarness` in the request body is REJECTED if it doesn't match the derived identity.** | Body fields are forgeable; token binding is not |
| `parent_slug` sealing | `parent_slug = <derivedCallingHarness>` on `scaffold_harness`; never read from body | Real seal, not security theater |
| `from_slug` on messages | Always = `<derivedCallingHarness>`; body's `from` field rejected on mismatch | Stops cross-harness spoofing in the audit log |
| Token rotation | Out of scope for v1; manual deletion of harness + re-scaffold if compromised | v1 is correctness-floor; rotation is hardening |

### Action execution

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Endpoint shape | Slug-less `POST /api/admin/execute-action` with `targetSlug` in action body | Many actions cross harnesses; URL-as-context is the wrong frame |
| Verb dispatch | Single endpoint with `op` discriminator | Matches the deleted `org.ts` contract; matches `actions-block.ts`'s POST shape |
| State backend | PG (per-harness `harness_<slug>.messages`, `harness_shared.projects`) | Universal Schema + Zero sync already in place |
| Caller-supplied idempotency | `actionId` (UUID) supplied by caller; server returns same `result` on replay | Workers retry on flake; double-spinup is unrecoverable |
| Idempotency replay semantics | **Cache-is-authoritative.** Cached response returned without verifying side effects still exist. | Documented as v1 boundary; out-of-band mutations break replay correctness; v1.5 can add cache-and-verify |
| Per-action error shape | `{ok, actionId, error?, result?}`; ACTIONS array continues past mid-array failures | Matches `actions-block.ts` loop semantics |
| Per-verb timeouts | `scaffold_harness`: 5 min. All other verbs: 60s. | Scaffold legitimately needs minutes (`papercusp init`, schema scaffold, etc.); the rest are SQL or fast |
| `send_message` addressing | Any harness → any harness; receiver decides whether to consume via prompt-build | Open bus, gated by receiver |
| `send_message` reason field | Required `reason: string` (min 10 chars; warn on placeholder regex but don't block) | Friction filters trivial chatter |
| `spinup_project` partial-failure semantics | Wrapped in a single PG transaction across all affected per-harness schemas. All-or-nothing. | Atomicity > diagnostic detail at v1 |
| `scaffold_harness` slug uniqueness | `INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`; if conflict → 409 with `error: 'slug already in use'` | Don't write to someone else's schema |

### Parent / child structure

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Parent/child relationship | Optional `parent_slug` column on `harness_shared.projects`, mirrored to `.papercusp/config.json.parent_slug` | Structural fact at the registry level; substrate code reads it |
| Completion-reporting hook | Default `afterDone.sh` ships in `libs/papercusp/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/` and fires when the harness has `parent_slug` set | One canonical impl, opt-in by config |
| Hook resolution chain | `<harness-dir>/.papercusp/hooks/<name>.sh` → `<libs>/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/<name>.sh`. **Resolver scans `builtins/` generically; afterDone is the only v1 builtin shipped.** | New builtins (e.g. `onPostValidator.sh`) are then a one-file PR in v1.5+ |
| User-supplied per-harness hook | Wins over builtin | Standard hook resolution; backward compatible |

### Marketplace contract

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Template "spawnable" contract | New manifest field `spawnable: { kind: 'coding'\|'service'\|..., requires: [...] }` in `papercusp.json` | Marketplace knows which templates a director can pick from |
| Spawnable-templates discovery | `GET /api/marketplace/spawnable` returns catalog filtered to `spawnable` entries | Director prompt builds available templates list at runtime |
| `scaffold_harness` template validation | Executor rejects `template` not in spawnable catalog | Prevents directors from spawning marketing-only templates |
| Adding `spawnable` to existing templates | Bumps patch version (`0.1.0` → `0.1.1`) and re-publishes; documented as the marketplace contract for "additive manifest field" | Avoids undefined-behavior on cached clients |

### Cross-harness visibility (tiered)

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 — Substrate self-description | Every prompt includes a fixed "## About Papercusp" preamble (~300 tokens, identical across all harnesses) | Coherence: orchestrators understand they're running inside a multi-harness framework |
| Tier 2 — Neighbor view | Every prompt includes a depth-1 view of: parent (if any), children (if any), siblings sharing same `parent_slug` | Bounded growth, sufficient for relational coordination |
| Tier 2 detail level | Parent: slug + recent activity 1-liner + last message between us. Children: slug + feature status counts + last activity ts + **`spawned_count: N`** for grandchild visibility hint. Siblings: slug + status counts. **Plus an aggregate roll-up.** | ~50 tokens each + ~20 tokens roll-up; prevents prompt bloat while flagging where Tier 3 inspection is warranted |
| Tier 3 — Inspect-on-demand | Read APIs (`/api/harness/projects`, `/api/harness/<slug>/status`, `/api/harness/<slug>/inbox`, `/api/harness/all/recent-activity`) listed in prompt as "available capabilities"; agent invokes when relevant | Full visibility achievable; pay only when needed |
| Tier 3 invocation mechanism | **Verified in Step 0.5** — either `Bash` is wired into `--allowed-tools` (so curl works), or a new MCP tool server `mcp__papercusp__inspectHarness({slug})` etc. ships in Step 2.5. **Without this, Tier 3 is dead text.** | Don't promise Tier 3 in prompts the agent can't act on |
| Cross-harness inbox consumption | Each harness's orchestrator/scoper/worker prompt-build includes its own bounded inbox; consumed messages auto-ack ONLY when orchestrator decision ∈ `{DONE, NEXT_*}`; `ESCALATE`/`REVIEW` leave pending | Parent → child mid-mission supervision reaches the agents; user-escalation messages aren't eaten |

### Autonomy (deferred to v2 plan)

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Autonomy substrate | TBD pending Step 0 spike | Routine plugin if substrate is durable across operator restarts; otherwise PG-backed work queue or systemd timer |

## 5. Steps

### Step 0 — Routine substrate spike *(\~30 min)*

Read `libs/papercusp/packages/plugin-loader/src/routines.ts` (or wherever routines live) and answer:

**Does the routine ticker survive operator process restart?**

- If yes: commit to routine plugin for v2 autoLoop.
- If no: pivot to `pending_events` table + a separate ticker process (systemd timer or sidecar daemon).

**Output:** decision note in `docs/decisions/routine-durability.md`.

**Gate:** none — informational only; this plan doesn't depend on the answer.

### Step 0.5 — Action-body + auth contract *(\~2 hours)*

Single 2–3 page document at `apps/operator/app/api/_hono/execute-action.contract.md`:

**Auth model:**

- Per-harness token: 256-bit random, base64url, generated at scaffold time, stored at `.papercusp/config.json:harness_token` mode 0600
- Auth header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` required on every request
- Identity derivation: server queries `harness_shared.token_index` to derive `<derivedCallingHarness>`; if no match → 401
- Body's `callingHarness`: must equal `<derivedCallingHarness>` or be omitted; mismatch → 403
- Body's `from` (in `send_message`): must equal `<derivedCallingHarness>`; mismatch → 403
- `parent_slug` (in `scaffold_harness`): NEVER body-controlled; always set by server to `<derivedCallingHarness>`

**Tier 3 verification (the inspect_harness capability):**

- Confirm whether `claude -p` invocations from `run.sh` include `Bash` in `--allowed-tools`.
- If yes: agent can curl Tier 3 endpoints directly. Step 2.5 is just docs.
- If no: ship `mcp__papercusp__inspectHarness` MCP tools in Step 2.5 wrapping the read endpoints.
- Document the chosen mechanism in this contract.

**Endpoint:**

- `POST /api/admin/execute-action`
- Request body:
  ```ts
  {
    actionId: string,        // UUID supplied by caller, idempotency key
    callingHarness?: string, // optional; must match Bearer-derived if present
    callingDept?: string,    // backwards-compat for run.sh (informational only)
    action: { op: '...', ... }
  }
  ```
- Per-verb request fields:
  - `send_message`: `to[], kind, subject, body, parentMessageId?, reason: string` *(`from` derived)*
  - `mark_message_status`: `messageId, status: 'acknowledged' | 'archived'`
  - `spinup_project`: `directiveId, projectName, projectVertical, projectBudgetCents, departments[]`
  - `scaffold_harness`: `projectSlug, template, spec, goal` *(`parent_slug` derived)*
- Response: `{ok, actionId, result?, error?}`
- Idempotency: same `actionId` → cached response, no re-execution, no side-effect verification (cache-is-authoritative)
- Error categories: `validation_error` (400), `auth_error` (401|403), `not_found` (404), `conflict` (409), `internal` (500)
- Per-verb timeouts: `scaffold_harness` 5 min, others 60s

**Gate:** committed to repo.

### Step 1 — PG schema migration (historical / superseded)

Update `bin/scaffold-harness-schema.sh` to add to every per-harness schema:

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.config_token (
  token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.messages (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  from_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT,
  parent_message_id UUID,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  acknowledged_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'acknowledged', 'archived'))
);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.messages (status, created_at);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.messages (to_slug, status);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.messages (from_slug, created_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.supervisor_notes (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.executed_actions (
  action_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  op TEXT NOT NULL,
  caller_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_slug TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  request JSONB NOT NULL,
  response JSONB NOT NULL,
  executed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.executed_actions (caller_slug, executed_at);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.executed_actions (target_slug, executed_at);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.executed_actions (op, executed_at);
```

And to `harness_shared`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE harness_shared.projects
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_slug TEXT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_parent ON harness_shared.projects (parent_slug);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_shared.token_index (
  token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  harness_slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

**Idempotent migration script** `bin/migrate-installed-harnesses-add-messages.sh`:

- For each row in `harness_shared.projects`:
  - If the project path doesn't exist on disk → log "skip (orphaned registry row)" and continue
  - Else: provision new tables in `harness_<slug>` (idempotent via `IF NOT EXISTS`)
  - Generate a fresh token, write to `<project_path>/.papercusp/config.json` (chmod 0600), insert into both `harness_<slug>.config_token` and `harness_shared.token_index`
- At end, print summary: `provisioned: N, skipped: M (broken rows), errors: K`

**Verify:** apply against an existing harness; confirm tables; re-run; confirm idempotent. Apply against the 7 currently-broken `papercup-org*` rows; confirm "skipped: 7."

**Gate:** all installed harnesses (with valid project paths) have the new tables + tokens; broken rows logged but not failed.

### Step 2 — executeAction with 4 verbs + auth *(\~3.5d)*

New file `apps/operator/app/api/admin/execute-action/route.ts`.

**Auth middleware *(\~0.5d)*:**

- Reject if no `Authorization: Bearer` header (401).
- Look up bearer in `harness_shared.token_index`; if no match → 401.
- Set `derivedCallingHarness = <slug from match>` on request context.
- If body has `callingHarness` and it doesn't match → 403 with clear error.
- If verb is `send_message` and body has `from` and it doesn't match → 403.
- If verb is `scaffold_harness` and body has `parent_slug` → 400 (validation error).

**Three SQL-only verbs *(\~1d)*:**

- `send_message`: validate `reason` ≥ 10 chars; placeholder-regex match logs warning to `executed_actions.reason` but proceeds. INSERT into `harness_<to_slug>.messages` with `from_slug = <derivedCallingHarness>`. If `kind === 'Directive'`, also append to `harness_<to_slug>.supervisor_notes`.
- `mark_message_status`: UPDATE `harness_<derivedCallingHarness>.messages` (only your own inbox/outbox is yours to mark) `SET status = $2, acknowledged_at = now() WHERE id = $1`.
- `spinup_project`: opens a PG transaction across all affected schemas; INSERT into `harness_shared.projects`; for each requested department, recurse-in-process to fire follow-up `send_message` (kickoff/priority/budget) within the same transaction. Single COMMIT or single ROLLBACK. Returns `{subActions: [{actionId, op, ok}, ...]}` for diagnostic detail.

**`scaffold_harness` *(\~1.75d)*:**

- Validate `projectSlug`, `template`, `spec`, `goal`.
- Look up `template` in the spawnable catalog. If not present or `spawnable` field absent, reject with `validation_error: 'template not spawnable'`.
- Check slug uniqueness: query `harness_shared.projects WHERE slug = $1`. If exists → 409 `slug already in use`.
- Shell out to `papercusp init <projectSlug> --from <template>` with **5-minute** timeout.
- After init succeeds, atomically merge `parent_slug: <derivedCallingHarness>` into the new harness's `.papercusp/config.json`.
- Generate `harness_token`, write to the new harness's `.papercusp/config.json` (chmod 0600).
- Call internal harness-projects registration with `parent_slug` (which provisions the per-harness PG schema, including the new `config_token` + `token_index` rows).
- On partial scaffold (init succeeded, register failed): error response includes the partially-created path so retry with same `actionId` cleans up + retries. Idempotency check on `executed_actions` short-circuits before any FS work.
- On `papercusp init` failure: rollback any partial directory creation, return `internal` error with stderr.
- On 5-min timeout: SIGTERM → SIGKILL → rollback, return `internal` error with `timeout: true`.

**Idempotency wrapper *(\~0.25d)*:**

```ts
const cached = await getExecutedAction(actionId, callerSlug);
if (cached) return cached.response;  // cache-is-authoritative; documented
const result = await dispatch(action);
await saveExecutedAction({
  actionId, op: action.op, callerSlug: derivedCallingHarness,
  targetSlug: extractTargetSlug(action), reason: action.reason ?? null,
  request: action, response: result,
});
return result;
```

Verify each verb individually with curl (using a real bearer token), including auth-failure paths; commit each verb as its own commit.

**Gate:** all four verbs return 200 on happy path + 4xx on validation failures + 401/403 on auth failures + 409 on slug conflicts + idempotent on `actionId` replay.

Wire into the `claude -p` invocation in run.sh's per-role spawn. Document the tool names in the prompt-build's "Available capabilities" section. \~0.5d.

**Gate:** an agent invoked with the new prompt CAN actually invoke an inspect call and receive a response. Verified end-to-end.

### Step 3 — Read APIs + tiered visibility prompt-build *(\~1.75d)*

#### 3a — Per-harness reads

In `apps/operator/app/api/_hono/harness.ts`:

- `GET /api/harness/:slug/inbox?status=pending&limit=20`
- `GET /api/harness/:slug/outbox?limit=20`
- `GET /api/harness/:slug/supervisor-notes?limit=10`
- `POST /api/harness/:slug/messages` → thin wrapper that calls executeAction with `op: 'send_message'`, using the slug's own token internally so the user can curl directives without managing tokens
- `GET /api/harness/projects?parent_slug=<slug>` → list a harness's children

#### 3b — Cross-harness reads (Tier 3)

- `GET /api/marketplace/spawnable` → catalog filtered to `spawnable` entries
- `GET /api/harness/all/recent-activity?limit=20` → last N audit events across all harnesses, ordered by ts desc
- existing `GET /api/harness/projects` and `GET /api/harness/:slug/status` are reused

#### 3c — Tiered visibility in prompt-build

Update `libs/papercusp/packages/orchestrator/src/prompt-build.ts` (and the bash equivalent in `run.sh`) to assemble every role's prompt with three new sections:

**Tier 1 — "About Papercusp" preamble** (identical for every prompt):

````markdown
## About Papercusp

You are an agent inside a Papercusp harness — an autonomous-harness framework
where role-based agent crews ("harnesses") build features.

- Each harness has a SPEC, a feature backlog, and a role crew (orchestrator,
  scoper, worker, validator, ...). Yours is below.
- Harnesses can have a parent and/or children, related via `parent_slug`.
  Yours is shown below.
- Harnesses can message each other via the `send_message` action (gated by
  your role's `allowedActions`). Always include a `reason` of ≥10 chars.
- The substrate is the same for every harness — yours and everyone else's.
- You can inspect any other harness on demand via the read APIs listed in
  "Available capabilities" below.
````

<Aside type="caution">
**Host drift:** the `localhost:3055` in these examples is the plan's original
target. On the shipped/release operator the API host is **`:3070`**
(`PAPERCUSP_HONO_PORT`); `:3055` is only the Vite SPA dev server, which proxies
`/api → :3070` in dev and is absent on the release operator. An agent copying
these curls should target `:3070`. See
`packages/operator-core/lib/operator-api-base.ts`.
</Aside>

#### 3d — Bounded inbox in own prompt

Every role's prompt also includes its own inbox bounded to last 20 pending messages.

**Gate:** on a fresh papercup-org install, building the parent director's prompt returns one with all 4 sections. Token count: less than 2k tokens of substrate framing for an org with 7 harnesses + 6 children visible.

### Step 4 — Retarget callers *(\~0.5d)*

`libs/papercusp/packages/orchestrator/src/actions-block.ts`:
- Default `apiUrl` from env `PAPERCUSP_OPERATOR_BASE` (default `http://localhost:3055`).
- Endpoint: `/api/admin/execute-action` (slug-less per locked decision).
- Body includes `actionId: randomUUID()`. Bearer token read from harness's own `.papercusp/config.json:harness_token`.
- `callingHarness` field omitted from body (server derives it).

`libs/papercusp/packages/harness/run.sh` (the `process_actions_block` curl):
- Same retarget. Generate UUID inline (`uuidgen`). Read token via `jq -r .harness_token .papercusp/config.json`. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Bump the `libs/papercusp` submodule pin in `papercup/`.

**Gate:** end-to-end manual probe — run a department harness's worker that emits an ACTIONS block with `send_message`, confirm executeAction receives it on `:3055` with the token, confirm `from_slug` in `messages` matches the harness's actual slug (not body-claimed).

### Step 4.5 — Builtin completion hook *(\~0.5d)*

New file `libs/papercusp/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/afterDone.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Built-in: notify parent harness on mission completion.
# Fires only when this harness has parent_slug set in .papercusp/config.json.
# User-supplied .papercusp/hooks/afterDone.sh overrides this entirely.
set -e
PARENT_SLUG="$(jq -r '.parent_slug // empty' .papercusp/config.json 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$PARENT_SLUG" ] && exit 0  # no parent, silent success

TOKEN="$(jq -r '.harness_token // empty' .papercusp/config.json 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$TOKEN" ] && { echo "afterDone: no harness_token in config; skipping" >&2; exit 0; }

SELF_SLUG="$(jq -r '.slug // empty' .papercusp/config.json 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$SELF_SLUG" ] && SELF_SLUG="$(basename "$PWD")"

ACTION_ID="$(uuidgen)"
BASE="${PAPERCUSP_OPERATOR_BASE:-http://localhost:3055}"

curl -sS --max-time 30 -X POST "$BASE/api/admin/execute-action" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d "$(jq -nc \
    --arg id "$ACTION_ID" \
    --arg to "$PARENT_SLUG" \
    '{actionId: $id, action: {op: "send_message", to: [$to], kind: "Completion", subject: "mission DONE", body: "", reason: "afterDone substrate hook: notifying parent of mission completion"}}')" \
  > /dev/null
```

Update `run.sh`'s `run_hook` to scan `${HARNESS_LIB_DIR}/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/` for any matching `<name>.sh` and fall through when no per-harness override exists. Generic resolver, ship one builtin (`afterDone`) for v1.

**Gate:** seed `parent_slug` + `harness_token` in a test harness's config.json, run a short mission to DONE, verify the parent's `harness_<parent>.messages` table has the Completion row with `from_slug = <child-slug>`.

### Step 4.6 — Bounded inbox in coding-harness prompt-build *(\~0.5d)*

Update prompt-build for orchestrator, scoper, and worker so each iteration's prompt includes:

````markdown
## Recent supervisor messages (from parent: <parent_slug>)
- 2026-05-01T14:32 [BudgetIncrease] from papercup-org-business: "raised your budget to $500"
- 2026-05-01T14:18 [Priority] from papercup-org: "focus on auth before dashboard"
````

Drawn from `harness_<self>.messages WHERE to_slug = <self> AND status = 'pending' AND from_slug = <parent_slug> ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5`.

**Auto-acknowledge scoping:** at end of iteration, if orchestrator decision ∈ `{DONE, NEXT_WORKER, NEXT_VALIDATOR, NEXT_ARCHITECT, NEXT_HARNESS, ...}` (the "happy progression" verbs), mark consumed messages as `acknowledged`. If decision ∈ `{ESCALATE, REVIEW, FEATURE_FREEZE}` or iteration fails non-zero, leave messages pending so the next iteration (after user intervention) sees them again.

**Gate:** drop a `send_message` from a parent harness to a running child; the child's next iteration's prompt includes it; after the iteration completes with `NEXT_WORKER`, the message status flips to `acknowledged`. Repeat with an iteration that `ESCALATE`s; verify message remains pending.

### Step 6 — Four integration smokes *(\~2d)*

#### Smoke A — papercup-org happy path

```
1. Reset state: prune any existing papercup-org* rows + delete project dirs.
2. Reinstall: papercusp install papercup-org.
3. Drop directive into parent inbox via curl POST /api/harness/papercup-org/messages,
   kind=Directive, body="write a single static index.html that says 'hello world'".
4. Manually invoke parent director:
   curl POST /api/harness/papercup-org/invoke?role=director.
5. Wait up to 5 min for the director run to complete.
6. Assert: parent's executed_actions table has at least one spinup_project and one
   scaffold_harness, each with a non-empty `reason`, with caller_slug = papercup-org.
7. Assert: a new child harness slug appears in GET /api/harness/projects with hasState=true,
   hasSpec=true, parent_slug=papercup-org.
8. Assert: the child's harness_<slug> PG schema exists with messages + executed_actions tables
   + a config_token row.
9. Manually invoke the child loop with a generous timeout: papercusp run <child-slug>
   --max-iterations 10.
10. Wait until the child writes its first non-trivial file (an index.html with content)
    OR reaches DONE — whichever comes first, max 5 min.
11. Assert: builtin afterDone hook fired (only if DONE was reached) — executed_actions
    has a send_message op with from_slug=<child-slug>, kind='Completion', reason populated.
12. Assert: parent's GET /inbox shows the Completion message at status='pending'
    (or, if step 10 stopped at "first file written," assert that the child has a real
    file on disk — proves the spawn produced a working harness even if it didn't
    fully complete).
```

#### Smoke B — generic harness spawning (proves the feature is generic)

```
1. Create a fresh harness "test-spawner-org" via:
   papercusp init test-spawner-org --target /tmp/test-spawner-org.
2. Hand-edit .papercusp/config.json to set:
     harness_kind: 'org'
     roles.director.allowedActions = ["scaffold_harness", "send_message"]
3. Drop a directive into its inbox via curl.
4. Manually invoke its director.
5. Assert: director emits scaffold_harness for some spawnable template (e.g. papercup-coding).
6. Assert: child appears in registry with parent_slug=test-spawner-org.
7. Run child to DONE.
8. Assert: builtin afterDone fires; Completion message lands in test-spawner-org's inbox.
```

If Smoke B passes without any code referencing "papercup-org" by name, the substrate is generic.

#### Smoke C — tiered visibility & cross-harness coordination

```
1. From the papercup-org install (Smoke A's state):
2. Build the prompt for parent director (without invoking claude — emit only):
   curl GET /api/harness/papercup-org/prompt?role=director.
3. Assert: prompt contains "## About Papercusp" preamble.
4. Assert: prompt contains "## Neighbor harnesses" with 6 children listed including
   spawned_count fields and an aggregate roll-up.
5. Assert: prompt contains "## Available read capabilities" listing inspect endpoints.
6. Assert: prompt total framing tokens (excluding own SPEC + state) <= 2000.
7. From a department harness, build its prompt:
   curl GET /api/harness/papercup-org-business/prompt?role=director.
8. Assert: prompt contains parent (papercup-org) in neighbor view + 5 siblings.
9. Send a parent → child supervisor message:
   curl POST /api/admin/execute-action (with papercup-org's token), op=send_message,
   to=[papercup-org-business], kind=Priority, body="focus on auth",
   reason="testing supervisor channel".
10. Build the child's worker prompt:
    curl GET /api/harness/papercup-org-business/prompt?role=worker.
11. Assert: prompt's "## Recent supervisor messages" section contains the Priority message.
12. Run worker once with NEXT_WORKER outcome.
13. Assert: the message's status is now 'acknowledged'.
14. Send another supervisor message; run worker once with ESCALATE outcome.
15. Assert: the message remains 'pending' (auto-ack scope honored).
```

#### Smoke D — auth model holds

```
1. Send executeAction with no Authorization header.
   Assert: 401.
2. Send with bogus bearer token.
   Assert: 401.
3. Send with valid token for harness X, body claiming callingHarness: 'Y'.
   Assert: 403 with clear error about identity mismatch.
4. Send valid send_message with body.from = 'Y' (X's token).
   Assert: 403.
5. Send valid scaffold_harness with body.parent_slug = 'attacker-controlled'.
   Assert: 400 (validation_error: parent_slug not caller-controlled) OR
           the field is silently dropped and parent_slug is set to X (verify which).
6. Send valid scaffold_harness with projectSlug = 'papercup-org' (already exists).
   Assert: 409, slug already in use.
7. Send executeAction with reason='asdf'.
   Assert: 200 (proceeds) but executed_actions row carries a quality flag.
8. Send executeAction with reason='' or missing.
   Assert: 400, validation_error.
```

**Gate for ship:** all four smokes pass twice from clean state.

## 7. Risks

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Routine substrate is in-process; no v2 autonomy path is viable | High for v2, none for this plan | Step 0 surfaces this early |
| Existing templates don't have `spawnable` field; `scaffold_harness` can't find anything to spawn | High | Step 5b explicitly re-publishes; Smoke A validates |
| `inspect_harness` capability isn't actually wired; Tier 3 is dead text | High | Step 0.5 verifies; Step 2.5 wires if needed; gate before Step 3 |
| `claude -p` doesn't preserve auth tokens cleanly across invocations (env leak risk) | Med | Tokens from `.papercusp/config.json`, mode 0600, never logged; verify in Smoke D |
| Tier 2 neighbor view explodes for orgs with 15+ children | Med | Smoke C asserts \<2000 tokens for 6 children; if violated, paginate |
| `scaffold_harness` shell-out flakes (init fails halfway) | Med | Idempotency on `actionId` + rollback of partial scaffold + 5-min timeout with SIGTERM/SIGKILL |
| Paperclip stomps the new files | Med | 2-day buffer; commit fast; monitor `pgrep -af paperclip` |
| Auto-acknowledge in Step 4.6 marks ESCALATE-iteration messages consumed | Med | Scope: ack only on DONE/NEXT_*; explicitly tested in Smoke C step 14-15 |
| Out-of-band registry mutation breaks idempotency replay (cache-is-authoritative) | Med | Documented as v1 boundary; not a v1 bug |
| Cross-harness messaging gets noisy without throttling | Med | `reason` field min-10-char + placeholder regex flag; v2 adds throttling if usage data shows \>50/day per harness |
| `spinup_project` cross-schema transaction has unexpected isolation issues | Med | Use serializable isolation; if cross-schema TX is problematic, fall back to sub-action retry pattern |
| Token compromise has no rotation path in v1 | Med | Documented in `auth-and-identity.mdx`; mitigation = uninstall+reinstall harness |
| Hook resolver scans `builtins/` but new builtins might collide with user hooks | Low | User hook always wins; lookup order documented |
| Recursive spawning blows up | Low | Smokes don't exercise; v2 concern |
| `executed_actions` grows unbounded | Low | 30-day prune in v1.5 |
| `harness_shared.token_index` lookup contention under load | Low | Indexed PK; v1 traffic is hand-driven |

## 8. Acceptance criteria

- All 4 verbs implemented and individually green via authenticated curl
- All 4 verbs idempotent on `actionId` replay (cache-is-authoritative documented)
- All requests rejected with 401 if no/invalid bearer token
- All requests rejected with 403 if body claims a harness identity not bound to the bearer token
- `parent_slug` and `from_slug` always derived from the bearer token, never from body
- `papercusp install papercup-org@0.1.1` materializes 7 working harness dirs each with a `harness_token`
- Builtin `afterDone` hook fires for any harness with `parent_slug` set, including non-papercup-org harnesses
- At least one non-papercup-org template has `spawnable: true` and is reachable via `GET /api/marketplace/spawnable`
- `papercup-org` template re-bundled with NO per-dept afterDone scripts
- Every prompt includes the "About Papercusp" preamble + neighbor view (with `spawned_count` + aggregate) + Tier 3 capabilities
- Tier 3 capability is verified to actually work end-to-end (agent can inspect)
- Coding-harness prompt-build includes own bounded inbox; auto-ack only on DONE/NEXT_* decisions
- `send_message` requires `reason` ≥10 chars; placeholder regex matches log a quality flag
- `scaffold_harness` enforces slug uniqueness with 409
- `scaffold_harness` 5-minute timeout enforced
- `spinup_project` recursion is transactional (all-or-nothing across schemas)
- Migration script handles broken registry rows: skip + log
- Smoke A passes twice from clean state
- Smoke B passes twice from clean state — no code in either path references "papercup-org" by name
- Smoke C passes twice — neighbor view + cross-harness messaging + auto-ack scoping verified
- Smoke D passes twice — auth model holds against forgery attempts
- No regressions in `sheets` standalone coding-harness flow
- Estimates updated to actuals; deltas analyzed
